stem: ![](asset:P000253-stem-1)Two projectiles are projected at an angle α from two points on a plane inclined at an angle θ with the horizontal as shown. Which of the statements are correct:

options.A: The particles will collide in mid-air
options.B: The time of flight for each particle is same.
options.C: Both particles will strike the plane perpendicularly
options.D: The range of projectiles measured along the inclined surface is same.

assets.alt: An incline of angle θ with two particles, each launched with speed u at angle α to the incline's surface: one from near the bottom, directed up the slope, and one from higher up, directed down the slope.
Two projectiles on an incline: one thrown up the slope and one down it, each at angle α to the plane. Label: same u sin α across, same g cos θ, so the same time of flight.
